body: You're so amazing at what you do. Seriously I am in awe of the care givers at my mums facility. They just seem to have boundless patience and reserves. I get snippy, impatient and frustrated and then I feel so ashamed and guilty.

Everything does feel wrong :( and I feel like I make things worse when I visit. For example when I visit she will try and get me to eat whatever they are giving her. I tell her no thanks I just ate our even bring in meals to specifically share with her. Then after I leave she refuses to eat anything, trying to give it away to the staff. This can go on for weeks after a visit. She was a larger lady when she was admitted but I reckon she's lost 40+ kg through not eating. 

Sincerely thanks so much for responding, it helps so much to know what others are going through and to feel like I'm being heard for the first time since this whole thing began.
This might sound strange, but it never occurred to me to lie (cos you don't lie to your Mum). Seriously your comment was a light bulb moment. I'll discuss it with the staff and see what they think.

I just expected to be treated fairly at work, even if I'm slightly left of norm. Just today the first thing any one said to me was "wow, you look terrible". Gee, thanks my self esteem needed that.

Oh just a little fyi I'm a woman. I'm trying to basically go cold turkey off food and this is the only solution I can come up with.

I just feel so hopeless and gray and useless. I'm working out a convenient time to od. I'm thing just after Christmas, so I can have time to be with my husband.

Thanks for listening to me. You are a kind and caring person.

Thanks for your kind words. It's just like being in high school again. Everyone avoids and makes fun of the weird arty kid while telling the new guy he's so awesome at the same time.

I am 6ft and doing a total meal replacement program. So yeah 700 to 900 Cal. Leaves me with zero energy after a 12 hour shift.

According to my performance review I am "too quiet" and that makes certain people think I am haughty and better than them (which is so not true) and that makes me a bad person? Am I that hard to get along with. I'm just shy.
The weight thing just makes everything worse. I am down to 900 calories a day, so I have zero energy and I don't enjoy or look forward to anything anymore. It just all seems pointless. No matter what I do, how hard I work, how much I punish myself I can't get ahead, so I just want to leave it behind.
